reddit.title: Introducing Ranks That Turn and March
reddit.body: We’ve made significant changes to how units move and attack in Provincia. No more teleporting soldiers or awkward formations! Check out our latest devtalk to learn about the new mechanics that enhance realism in battles. Read more here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/ranks-that-turn-and-march?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=ranks-that-turn-and-march
